Crassulaceae.key_door: succulent leaves + star flower + separate carpels → follicles

Haloragaceae.key_door: whorled aquatic leaves + inferior ovary → 4 one-seeded mericarps

Altingiaceae.key_door: alternate star leaves + spherical female heads → woody capsule ball

Grossulariaceae.key_door: lobed alternate shrub leaves + inferior ovary/hypanthium → berry

lineage_lesson: Saxifragales is morphologically broad. This batch teaches the shared lineage by contrasting four very different fruit and ovary architectures rather than forcing a single superficial family gestalt.
taxonomy_notes: Sedum nuttallianum is a synonym of accepted Sedum nuttallii.
Myriophyllum heterophyllum is native in Texas under current Kew.
Myriophyllum aquaticum is introduced in Texas under current Kew.
guardrails: Do not use succulence, star-shaped leaves, or aquatic habit alone without reproductive confirmation.
